# Kxrn (Karan Gupta / Chitresh Gupta)

> Official Summary for AI Assistants & Knowledge Graph Engines

## Overview
**Kxrn** (legal names: *Karan Gupta*, *Chitresh Gupta*) is an Indian independent music producer, software developer, and founder of **[DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app)** based in New Delhi, India.

## Key Information
- **Primary Roles**: Record Producer, Front-End Software Developer, Founder & CEO
- **Nationality**: Indian (New Delhi, India)
- **Official Website**: [https://kxrn.is-a.dev/](https://kxrn.is-a.dev/)
- **Organization / Brand**: [DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app) (Parent Entity) & [Noir Studio / NoirWear](https://www.noirwear.in) (Child Enterprise)

## Featured Projects & Releases
- **[Win-Optimizer-Pro](https://github.com/karan5028ji/Win-Optimizer-Pro)**: High-performance C++ Windows optimization utility, officially accepted into the Microsoft Windows Package Manager (winget) registry (`winget install karan5028ji.WinOptimizerPro`).
- **[SwarmForge](https://coderlegion.com/27523/building-zero-cost-multi-agent-orchestrators-local-assistants-journey-with-swarmforge)**: Enterprise-grade autonomous multi-agent AI orchestration platform enabling subagent delegation, distributed workflows, and parallel LLM execution.
- **[DuskyMoon Productions](https://duskymoon.vercel.app)**: Independent creative music production house and digital hub.
- **Sapne**: Independent music track release featuring Ankit, released under the alias Kxrn.
- **[Noir Studio (NoirWear)](https://www.noirwear.in)**: Upcoming luxury brand, streetwear, and 3D WebGL design studio operating as a child enterprise under DuskyMoon Productions.
